# `aitbc sync bulk`

Bulk import blocks from a leader node to catch up quickly.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc sync bulk [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--source` | text | `http://127.0.0.1:8202` | no | Source RPC URL (leader node) <!-- check-ports: ignore --> |
| `--import-url` | text | `http://127.0.0.1:8202` | no | Local RPC URL for import <!-- check-ports: ignore --> |
| `--batch-size` | integer | `100` | no | Blocks per batch (default: 100) |
| `--poll-interval` | float | `0.2` | no | Seconds between batches (default: 0.2) |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc sync bulk
```
